title: Starfarers of the Drift
tagline: A small crew, a patched-up ship, a galaxy of problems
description: Original sci-fi exploration: the learner's crew inherits a starship and must earn fuel, maps, and respect by solving problems across the Drift. For learners who love space operas, mecha, and exploration anime.
worldPrompt: An original space-exploration adventure aboard a patched-up starship crossing the Drift. Each subject unit becomes a star system with a problem to solve before the ship can jump on. Original alien cultures, a quirky AI navigator, and rival salvagers.
